text: A head servo group (pan, tilt) on the base bus node: configurable IDs, ranges (defaults pan +-90 deg, tilt -30/+45 deg, servo centre 2048 = straight and level), per-joint speed/acceleration caps for position joints, joint_states published, commands on /head/joint_commands. The group runs on base_servos at the 50 Hz base bus rate (split epic budget: base + head 14.4 ms vs the 20 ms period).
Home pose looking forward and down at the ground (configurable, not the servo centre), used at startup, on Home, and whenever the controlling lease is released.

TF: robot_state_publisher with a head URDF (mount, pan axis from behind and above the lidar, tilt axis offset, rigid head frame, head_camera_optical_frame and tof_optical_frame with the configured spacing) driven by the head joint states; static_tf_publisher's roll/pitch bug fixed.

Agent (mcp_server + claude_agent): head tools to set pan/tilt, look at a point (aims the RGB camera axis once at a point in base_link or map) and home; usable under the arm or the base lease; releasing the lease returns the head home; camera-scene code stops assuming the head camera sits on base_link. Ruling R2: the head is not added to the arm self-collision model in this epic.
Web UI: Head tab pan/tilt sliders + Home button replacing the disabled placeholder, head drawn in the 3D view.
Tests with fake buses/robots; READMEs; deployed; first live test +-5 deg pan only, then widened.
Head servos on the base bus (shared with swerve), separate from the arm bus.

IDs, ranges and mount configurable; defaults pan +-90 deg, tilt -30/+45 deg, servo centre 2048 = straight and level; mount ~35 cm up, ~10 cm left, ~15 cm forward of base_link; the pan post comes from behind and above the lidar covering as little of its view as possible; camera-to-ToF spacing configurable in the head URDF.
Per-joint speed/acceleration caps; first live test +-5 deg pan only.
Home pose looks forward and down at the ground (configurable, not the servo centre).
Agent look-at aims the RGB camera axis once at a point in base_link or map, no tracking; zoom does not auto-aim.
The head can be moved under the arm lease OR the base lease (belongs to both); releasing the controlling lease moves the head back home.
Web UI: Head tab pan/tilt sliders + Home button, head drawn in the 3D view.
Orchestrator ruling: web UI head commands are always allowed (operator); last writer wins against the agent; the agent's head tools need the arm or the base lease.
Orchestrator ruling: the tilt sign is a config value with a documented default, positive tilt = looking down (matches home forward and down); decided, confirmed by the user on 2026-10-18.
